cohort: The study included 69 cases of maternal mortality that occurred in the Eastern province of Turkey between January 2010 and December 2016.
finding: Preeclamptic diseases and hemorrhage were the most common direct causes of maternal mortality, while cerebrovascular diseases, heart diseases, and sepsis were the most common indirect causes.
followup_time: until maternal death, with a mean postpartum death time of 13.7 days.
gest_age: mean 32.3 ± 7.4 weeks at the time of mortality
